n. the manner in which an electrical or mechanical device responds to an input signal or a range of input signals
n. a phrase recited or sung by the congregation following a versicle by the priest or minister

name: refreshing
trans: adj. imparting vitality and energy
adj. pleasantly new or different

name: oblivious
trans: adj. failing to keep in mind
adj. (followed by `to' or `of') lacking conscious awareness of

name: category
trans: n. a general concept that marks divisions or coordinations in a conceptual scheme
n. a collection of things sharing a common attribute

name: rival
trans: v. be the rival of, be in competition with
v. be equal to in quality or ability
n. the contestant you hope to defeat
